-- Identity providers (OpenID Connect). Apply as a NEW numbered migration after
-- the accounts schema. Every statement is IF NOT EXISTS, so a store that applied
-- an earlier version of this file applies the current one again as its next
-- migration and gains only what it lacks.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_transactions (
  state_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  binding_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  config_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  payload TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_limits (
  bucket TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  count INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
-- One pinned link per configured provider. Linking stores the issuer, JWKS URI,
-- client id, endpoints and allowed algorithms; a changed configuration only
-- records a pending re-link, which the owner completes with a step-up proof.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_identity_providers (
  provider_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  preset TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('linked','unlinked')),
  issuer TEXT NOT NULL,
  client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  jwks_uri TEXT NOT NULL,
  authorization_endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,
  token_endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,
  algorithms TEXT NOT NULL,
  token_auth_method TEXT NOT NULL,
  response_iss INTEGER NOT NULL,
  interface_version TEXT,
  linked_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  pending_issuer TEXT,
  pending_client_id TEXT,
  pending_preset TEXT,
  pending_at INTEGER,
  jwks TEXT,
  jwks_fetched_at INTEGER
);
-- Reachability per configured provider, linked or not. A provider that has
-- failed discovery or JWKS for 5 minutes, or answered 404 or a DNS failure, is
-- hidden from the sign-in page until a later check succeeds.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_identity_provider_health (
  provider_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  failing_since INTEGER,
  hard_failure_at INTEGER,
  checked_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);

-- ADMIN-004 / SEND-001: versioned per-source send policies. Every save appends an immutable version that keeps the
-- settings it replaced; the current policy of a source is its highest version, and a source never saved uses the built-in
-- default (version 0). Only the account scope exists until groups and profiles ship (ADMIN-002, ADMIN-008).
CREATE TABLE iw_send_policy_versions (
  scope TEXT NOT NULL,
  source TEXT NOT NULL,
  version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version>0),
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(mode IN ('off','person','autonomous')),
  templates TEXT,
  require_internal_approval INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(require_internal_approval IN (0,1)),

);

CREATE TRIGGER iw_usage_activity AFTER INSERT ON iw_usage_notices BEGIN

-- ADMIN-005: adopt immutable business histories and retain every future save.
-- Explicit projections exclude document content, field values, recipient data,
-- private replies and arbitrary nested payload fields.
-- Source histories carry authority independently of the request context.

-- Adopt existing records using their original actor and timestamp.
INSERT INTO iw_account_audit(id,at,actor_id,action,target,before_json,after_json)
 SELECT lower(hex(randomblob(16))),
  h.at,
  h.actor,
  'freeform.changed',
  'settings:freeform',
  json_object('enabled',json(CASE WHEN h.before_value=1 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END),'version',h.version-1),
  json_object('enabled',json(CASE WHEN h.after_value=1 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END),'version',h.version)
 FROM iw_freeform_history h;

CREATE TRIGGER iw_audit_freeform_history AFTER INSERT ON iw_freeform_history
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO iw_account_audit(id,at,actor_id,action,target,before_json,after_json)
 SELECT lower(hex(randomblob(16))),
  NEW.at,
  NEW.actor,
  'freeform.changed',
  'settings:freeform',
  json_object('enabled',json(CASE WHEN NEW.before_value=1 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END),'version',NEW.version-1),
  json_object('enabled',json(CASE WHEN NEW.after_value=1 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END),'version',NEW.version);
END;

-- Adopt existing records using their original actor and timestamp.
INSERT INTO iw_account_audit(id,at,actor_id,action,target,before_json,after_json)
 SELECT lower(hex(randomblob(16))),
  h.at,
  h.actor,
  'send_policy.changed',
  'send-policy:'||h.scope||':'||h.source,
  json_object('mode',CASE WHEN json_extract(h.before_value,'$.mode') IN ('off','person','autonomous') THEN json_extract(h.before_value,'$.mode') END,'templates',json(CASE WHEN json_type(h.before_value,'$.templates')='array' THEN (SELECT json_group_array(value) FROM json_each(h.before_value,'$.templates') WHERE type='text') ELSE 'null' END),'requireInternalApproval',json(CASE WHEN json_type(h.before_value,'$.requireInternalApproval')='true' OR json_extract(h.before_value,'$.requireInternalApproval')=1 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END),'deferredRelease',json(CASE WHEN json_type(h.before_value,'$.deferredRelease')='true' OR json_extract(h.before_value,'$.deferredRelease')=1 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END),'version',CASE WHEN json_type(h.before_value,'$.version') IN ('integer','real') THEN json_extract(h.before_value,'$.version') END),
  json_object('scope',h.scope,'source',h.source,'mode',h.mode,'templates',json(CASE WHEN h.templates IS NULL THEN 'null' ELSE (SELECT json_group_array(value) FROM json_each(h.templates) WHERE type='text') END),'requireInternalApproval',json(CASE WHEN h.require_internal_approval=1 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END),'deferredRelease',json(CASE WHEN h.deferred_release=1 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END),'version',h.version,'reason',h.reason)
 FROM iw_send_policy_versions h;

  'send-policy:'||NEW.scope||':'||NEW.source,
  json_object('mode',CASE WHEN json_extract(NEW.before_value,'$.mode') IN ('off','person','autonomous') THEN json_extract(NEW.before_value,'$.mode') END,'templates',json(CASE WHEN json_type(NEW.before_value,'$.templates')='array' THEN (SELECT json_group_array(value) FROM json_each(NEW.before_value,'$.templates') WHERE type='text') ELSE 'null' END),'requireInternalApproval',json(CASE WHEN json_type(NEW.before_value,'$.requireInternalApproval')='true' OR json_extract(NEW.before_value,'$.requireInternalApproval')=1 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END),'deferredRelease',json(CASE WHEN json_type(NEW.before_value,'$.deferredRelease')='true' OR json_extract(NEW.before_value,'$.deferredRelease')=1 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END),'version',CASE WHEN json_type(NEW.before_value,'$.version') IN ('integer','real') THEN json_extract(NEW.before_value,'$.version') END),
  json_object('scope',NEW.scope,'source',NEW.source,'mode',NEW.mode,'templates',json(CASE WHEN NEW.templates IS NULL THEN 'null' ELSE (SELECT json_group_array(value) FROM json_each(NEW.templates) WHERE type='text') END),'requireInternalApproval',json(CASE WHEN NEW.require_internal_approval=1 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END),'deferredRelease',json(CASE WHEN NEW.deferred_release=1 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END),'version',NEW.version,'reason',NEW.reason);

INSERT INTO iw_account_audit(id,at,actor_id,action,target,before_json,after_json)

-- ADMIN-005: adopt existing follow-up and embedding events.
-- Existing event records retain their source actor and timestamp.
-- Reply bodies, reply headers, launch hashes, invitation material and
-- recipient hashes never enter these projections. Only fixed causes survive.
-- New credential and form transitions require the atomic request context.
-- Credential issuance predating this migration has no complete change history;
-- no past revoker, rotator or scope editor is inferred from the creator.

INSERT INTO iw_account_audit(id,at,actor_id,action,target,before_json,after_json)
 SELECT lower(hex(randomblob(16))),
  json_extract(h.data,'$.at'),
  json_extract(h.data,'$.actor'),
  json_extract(h.data,'$.action'),
  'envelope:'||h.envelope_id,
  NULL,
  json_object('sequence',h.sequence,'signer',CASE WHEN json_type(h.data,'$.detail.signer')='integer' THEN json_extract(h.data,'$.detail.signer') END,'version',CASE WHEN json_type(h.data,'$.detail.version')='integer' THEN json_extract(h.data,'$.detail.version') END,'memberId',CASE WHEN json_type(h.data,'$.detail.member')='text' THEN json_extract(h.data,'$.detail.member') END,'replyId',CASE WHEN json_type(h.data,'$.detail.reply')='text' THEN json_extract(h.data,'$.detail.reply') END,'cause',CASE WHEN json_extract(h.data,'$.detail.cause') IN ('bad address','contact limit','unavailable','substantive reply','unverified sender','not opened','opened and left','repeated views','corrected address proposed','address needs correcting','contact limit reached','return date is after expiry','SMS number changed or unavailable; renew the follow-up grant','invitation link unavailable') THEN json_extract(h.data,'$.detail.cause') END,'channel',CASE WHEN json_extract(h.data,'$.detail.channel') IN ('email','sms') THEN json_extract(h.data,'$.detail.channel') END)
 FROM iw_events h
 WHERE json_extract(h.data,'$.action') IN ('followup.granted','followup.revoked','followup.resumed','followup.viewed','followup.attention','followup.sent','followup.reply_received','followup.suspended','followup.ended');

WHEN json_extract(NEW.data,'$.action') IN ('followup.granted','followup.revoked','followup.resumed','followup.viewed','followup.attention','followup.sent','followup.reply_received','followup.suspended','followup.ended')

END;

INSERT INTO iw_account_audit(id,at,actor_id,action,target,before_json,after_json)
 SELECT lower(hex(randomblob(16))),
  h.at,
  h.actor,
  'embedding.'||h.action,
  'embedding:'||h.id,
  CASE WHEN h.action='origin.changed' THEN json_object('origin',json_extract(h.detail,'$.before')) ELSE NULL END,
  json_object('origin',h.origin,'envelopeId',h.envelope_id,'purpose',CASE WHEN json_extract(h.detail,'$.purpose') IN ('grant','sign','prepare','redeem','request','issue','launch','session') THEN json_extract(h.detail,'$.purpose') END,'outcome',CASE WHEN json_extract(h.detail,'$.outcome') IN ('allowed','refused','closed') THEN json_extract(h.detail,'$.outcome') END,'consent',json(CASE json_type(h.detail,'$.consent') WHEN 'true' THEN 'true' WHEN 'false' THEN 'false' ELSE 'null' END),'consentVersion',CASE WHEN json_extract(h.detail,'$.consentVersion') IN ('embedding-2026-10-26') THEN json_extract(h.detail,'$.consentVersion') END,'version',CASE WHEN json_type(h.detail,'$.version')='integer' THEN json_extract(h.detail,'$.version') END,'grantVersion',CASE WHEN json_type(h.detail,'$.grantVersion')='integer' THEN json_extract(h.detail,'$.grantVersion') END,'expiresAt',CASE WHEN json_type(h.detail,'$.expiresAt')='integer' THEN json_extract(h.detail,'$.expiresAt') END,'status',CASE WHEN json_type(h.detail,'$.status')='integer' THEN json_extract(h.detail,'$.status') END,'beforeEnabled',json(CASE WHEN json_type(h.detail,'$.before')='text' THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END),'afterEnabled',json(CASE WHEN json_type(h.detail,'$.after')='text' THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END))
 FROM iw_embed_audit h
